SEGMENT 1 (playback order)
EP01:E21 0-900 CAMERA: Low-angle shot from behind Juliana looking up at Gerald and the Lady in Gold Gown standing proudly before the altar.
EP01:E22 900-2500 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana's trembling lips and shocked, tearful blue eyes.
EP01:E23 1000-2200 LADY JULIANA: "Gerald?"
EP01:E24 2600-4900 LADY JULIANA: "Why are you holding her hand?"
EP01:E25 3700-6200 CAMERA: Close-up insert of Gerald's fingers firmly interlocked with the white-gloved hand of the Lady in Gold Gown.
EP01:E26 6200-8700 CAMERA: Close-up on the Lady in Gold Gown beaming with cruel triumph.
EP01:E27 6300-8400 LADY IN GOLD GOWN: "Because he is marrying me."
EP01:E28 8700-11100 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana as tears spill over her eyelashes.
EP01:E29 8900-10300 LADY JULIANA: "No..."
EP01:E30 11100-14000 CAMERA: Wide profile shot showing Juliana standing below the altar platform, looking up at Gerald and her sister.
EP01:E32 14000-17200 LADY JULIANA: "You knew this before I walked through those doors!"
EP01:E31 14000-17600 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana clutching her chest, her sorrow turning into burning outrage.
EP01:E33 17600-19200 CAMERA: Medium shot of Gerald standing stoic and impassive next to the smug Lady in Gold Gown.
EP01:E34 19200-21800 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana's hands desperately clenching fistfuls of her white dress fabric.
EP01:E35 20000-21800 LADY JULIANA: "You let me come here..."
EP01:E36 21800-24800 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana's tear-streaked face as she shakes with grief.
EP01:E37 21900-24100 LADY JULIANA: "You let me dress in my mother's gown..."
EP01:E38 24200-27200 LADY JULIANA: "You let me believe I was walking toward my husband!"
EP01:E39 24800-27300 CAMERA: Medium shot on Gerald stepping forward, cold and indifferent, with the Lady in Gold Gown lingering in soft focus behind him.
EP01:E41 27300-29000 THE FORMER GROOM: "I changed my mind."
EP01:E40 27300-30200 CAMERA: Tight close-up on Gerald's hardened profile as he glances down.
EP01:E42 30200-33200 CAMERA: Extreme close-up on Juliana's furious, weeping face.
EP01:E43 30600-32800 LADY JULIANA: "You swore you loved me!"
EP01:E44 33200-36000 CAMERA: Close-up on the Lady in Gold Gown smiling condescendingly.
EP01:E45 33700-36000 LADY IN GOLD GOWN: "People change their minds, sister."
EP01:E46 36000-39600 CAMERA: Medium profile shot of the Lady in Gold Gown turning her head subtly toward Gerald with satisfied malice.
EP01:E47 36300-37600 LADY JULIANA: "And you knew?"
EP01:E48 37800-39300 LADY IN GOLD GOWN: "Of course I knew."
EP01:E49 39600-41800 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana, stunned by the callous depth of the conspiracy.
EP01:E50 40300-41500 LADY JULIANA: "How long?"
EP01:E51 41800-46200 CAMERA: Medium two-shot of the Lady in Gold Gown and Gerald looking together down at Juliana.
EP01:E52 42200-45700 LADY IN GOLD GOWN: "Long enough to know he was never going to marry you."
EP01:E53 46200-48200 ACTION: Juliana turns abruptly toward the first row of pews, where her elderly father sits gripping an ornate brass cane.
EP01:E54 46200-48600 CAMERA: Close-up on the father's hand tightly gripping the gold curved handle of his walking cane.
EP01:E55 47300-48400 LADY JULIANA: "Father..."
EP01:E57 48600-50800 LADY JULIANA: "Tell them this is a mistake."
EP01:E56 48600-50800 CAMERA: Wide shot showing Juliana dropping to her knees beside her seated father, pleading with him.

EP02:E24 0-1800 CAMERA: Close-up of the father's stern, unyielding face.
EP02:E25 1800-4800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana turning toward her father in the pews, imploring him.

EP02:E31 12400-15200 CAMERA: Extreme close-up on Juliana's tear-drenched eyes as the sting of her father's rejection lands.

EP02:E34 15400-19000 LADY IN GOLD GOWN: "Why are you surprised, sister? Look at you."
EP02:E35 19100-21000 CAMERA: Tight insert on Clarissa's gloved fingers contemptuously pinching the satin folds of Juliana's gown.
EP02:E36 19200-20800 LADY IN GOLD GOWN: "That plain, old-fashioned gown."
EP02:E37 21000-24300 CAMERA: Medium shot of Clarissa smiling radiantly, condescendingly gesturing at Juliana.
EP02:E38 21100-24300 LADY IN GOLD GOWN: "You look like a kitchen maid who wandered into the wrong wedding."
EP02:E39 24300-25800 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana, whose tearful expression begins to tighten with quiet indignation.

EP02:E42 26200-28100 CAMERA: Medium shot returning to Clarissa laughing at Juliana's expense.

EP02:E45 28200-31100 LADY IN GOLD GOWN: "...not a dull creature who hides in her mother's apothecary herbs."
EP02:E46 31100-33600 CAMERA: High-angle wide shot of the grand cathedral aisle as a matriarch dressed in an ornate black velvet gown glides toward Juliana.
EP02:E47 31100-33600 ACTION: The matriarch steps into the center aisle, glaring down at Juliana with cold superiority.
EP02:E48 31200-33400 OFF-SCREEN VOICE: "Oh, don't look so wounded, Juliana."

EP02:E52 37000-40300 THE FORMER GROOM: "Go home quietly, Juliana. At least leave this chapel with some dignity."

EP11:E8 0-2600 CAMERA: Medium tracking shot as Juliana steps defensively toward Gerald, her face full of shock and anger.
EP11:E9 100-2500 JULIANA: "Gerald? What are you doing here?"
EP11:E10 2600-4800 CAMERA: Wide two-shot across the puddle-strewn ground between Gerald and Juliana against the misty landscape.
EP11:E11 2900-5000 GERALD: "I came for something that belongs to me."

EP11:E13 6100-8600 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana, her anger flaring as she gestures sharply.
EP11:E14 6200-8500 JULIANA: "You have already taken enough from me. Leave!"
EP11:E15 8600-10300 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Gerald pointing an accusatory finger, his composure snapping into hostile anger.
EP11:E16 8600-10500 GERALD: "Your husband stole my gold pocket watch!"
EP11:E17 10300-11800 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana recoiling in utter disbelief.
EP11:E18 10800-11800 JULIANA: "What? When?"
EP11:E19 11800-13800 CAMERA: Close-up of Gerald narrowing his eyes vindictively.
EP11:E20 12700-14100 GERALD: "The last time I came here."

EP11:E25 18700-20700 CAMERA: Three-shot of Alexander, Juliana, and Gerald in the bleak drizzle.

EP11:E29 24200-26700 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Alexander stepping past Juliana, his gaze murderous and jaw rigid.
EP11:E30 24800-26700 ALEXANDER: "Choose your next words carefully."
EP11:E31 26700-28800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Gerald pointing back toward the approaching Constable, feigning alarm.
EP11:E32 26900-28900 GERALD: "You hear that? He threatens me again!"
EP11:E33 28800-28900 CAMERA: Medium shot of the Constable marching into frame between them, holding his truncheon horizontally.

SEGMENT 1 (playback order)
EP11:E73 0-1800 CAMERA: Medium shot of the Constable stepping up behind Alexander, holding his truncheon firmly across Alexander's chest to restrain him, cutting to a tight close-up of Alexander's smoldering eyes.
EP11:E74 0-2000 ALEXANDER: "But one blow would destroy her life."
EP11:E75 1800-4000 CAMERA: Medium shot of the Constable turning to Alexander's heavy trench coat hanging on an iron wall hook by the fireplace.
EP11:E76 3000-4200 ACTION: The Constable grabs the coat by the collar and begins rummaging through its deep pockets.
EP11:E77 4100-5200 JULIANA: "That is his coat!"
EP11:E78 5200-8800 CAMERA: Close-up of the Constable's hand sliding deep inside the inner coat lining and withdrawing a gleaming gold pocket watch with an attached chain.
EP11:E79 7800-9000 SOUND: Metallic clinking of the gold chain sliding against fabric.
EP11:E80 8800-11200 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Juliana gasping in sheer horror, her eyes welling with shock and shattered disbelief.
EP11:E81 9200-11000 ACTION: Juliana draws a sharp, terrified breath as her face pales completely.
EP11:E82 11200-14000 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Alexander's face hardening into lethal, icy comprehension, realizing the depth of the frame-up.
EP11:E83 14000-18800 CAMERA: Medium close-up push-in on Gerald's face erupting into an ecstatic, wicked grin, bursting into triumphant laughter.
EP11:E84 16200-18600 GERALD: "There it is. Ha!"
EP11:E85 18800-24750 CAMERA: Tight macro shot of the gold pocket watch dangling and swaying gently from the Constable's fingers on its long chain, with Gerald blurred in the background grinning with sinister triumph as the scene hangs in a devastating freeze-frame.

CANDIDATE=c_d3038e669a203350 DURATION_MS=56100
SEGMENT 1 (playback order)
EP12:E1 0-100 CAMERA: Medium shot of the Constable raising a set of heavy iron handcuffs, addressing Alexander sternly in front of the stone hearth.
EP12:E3 100-4600 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana swiftly moving in front of Alexander, placing herself defiantly between him and the Constable's outstretched handcuffs.
EP12:E4 300-1500 ACTION: Juliana steps firmly forward, shielding Alexander with her body.
EP12:E5 1200-4300 JULIANA: "No! That watch was not in his coat!"
EP12:E6 4600-7300 CAMERA: Close-up of the Constable narrowing his eyes coldly at Juliana.
EP12:E7 5500-7200 CONSTABLE: "I found it there myself."
EP12:E8 7300-9400 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana glaring back with unwavering conviction.
EP12:E9 7800-9400 JULIANA: "Then someone put it there!"
EP12:E10 9400-16300 CAMERA: Medium full shot of Gerald framed in the open cottage doorway holding his riding crop, stepping inside with a patronizing, gloating grin.
EP12:E11 9800-16100 GERALD: "The proof is in his coat, Juliana. A valuable pocket watch doesn't just walk into a beggar's pocket."
EP12:E12 16300-19200 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander, his scarred brow furrowed in dark, quiet defiance.
EP12:E13 17100-19100 ALEXANDER: "I have never touched your property."
EP12:E15 19200-22300 GERALD: "Then perhaps your wife should explain why it was found in your coat."
EP12:E14 19200-22400 CAMERA: Medium shot of Gerald pointing his riding crop toward them, with Clarissa hovering behind him in her violet silk gown.
EP12:E17 22300-23400 JULIANA: "You planted it!"
EP12:E16 22300-23500 ACTION: Juliana lunges a step forward, jabbing an accusing finger toward Gerald.
EP12:E18 23500-25300 CAMERA: Medium shot of Clarissa gliding past Gerald, a venomous, amused smile playing upon her lips.
EP12:E19 23600-25500 CLARISSA: "Oh, dear sister..."
EP12:E20 25300-26500 CAMERA: Tight shot of Alexander's hand clenching into a tight, trembling fist against the glow of the roaring fireplace.
EP12:E22 25500-27900 CLARISSA: "...still defending your broken scrap of a man?"
EP12:E21 26500-27900 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander glaring daggers at Clarissa.
EP12:E24 27900-30700 JULIANA: "Name your price, Clarissa. I know you."
EP12:E23 27900-30800 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana, her eyes narrowing with sharp perception.
EP12:E25 30800-35500 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Clarissa smiling with vicious delight.
EP12:E26 30900-35500 CLARISSA: "You always were clever, Juliana. Always searching for some way to escape."
EP12:E27 35500-37300 CAMERA: Tight shot of Clarissa smoothing her long purple evening glove along her wrist.
EP12:E28 35600-37000 CLARISSA: "Perhaps I can give you one."
EP12:E29 37300-39200 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana watching her with cautious skepticism.
EP12:E30 37700-39000 JULIANA: "What do you want?"
EP12:E31 39200-42100 CAMERA: Medium two-shot of Clarissa in the foreground, turning slowly to face Juliana.
EP12:E32 39500-41900 CLARISSA: "I want to see you crawl, sister."
EP12:E33 42100-47900 CAMERA: Medium close-up profile tracking shot of Clarissa pacing slowly as she spins her sadistic tale.
EP12:E34 42200-47800 CLARISSA: "My emerald signet ring fell deep into the frozen blackthorn briars at Ashworth Manor. The thorns have grown over it..."
EP12:E36 47900-52200 CLARISSA: "...sharp as steel. The ground is frozen, like pure ice."
EP12:E35 47900-52300 CAMERA: Close-up of Clarissa flexing her gloved fingers theatrically in front of her face.
EP12:E37 52300-53500 ACTION: Gerald bursts into a loud, mocking laugh beside the stony Constable.
EP12:E38 52300-56100 CAMERA: Medium two-shot of Clarissa stepping closer to Juliana, peering down into her eyes with a predatory smile.
EP12:E39 52800-56100 CLARISSA: "You will retrieve it with your bare hands before the magistrate arrives."

SEGMENT 1 (playback order)
EP15:E6 0-100 CAMERA: Medium close-up of a bald thug leaning over a lush bed of white medicinal chamomile herbs.
EP15:E8 100-4400 CAMERA: Medium shot framing the open doorway of the stone cottage, bathed in warm interior light against the dark night.
EP15:E9 200-4400 ACTION: Juliana bursts through the cottage doorway, her hands wrapped in clean white bandages, freezing in horror at the destruction.
EP15:E10 1100-4300 JULIANA: "Stop! What are you doing?!"
EP15:E11 4400-8400 CAMERA: Medium close-up of the Thug with Cap holding the uprooted chamomile bouquet, sneering with cruel amusement.
EP15:E12 5600-8300 THUG WITH CAP: "We're clearing this rubbish."
EP15:E13 8400-11400 CAMERA: Close-up on Juliana, her face tight with anguish and fury as she clutches her bandaged hands against her chest.
EP15:E14 9000-11300 JULIANA: "Those are medicinal plants!"
EP15:E15 11400-15100 CAMERA: Low-angle shot tracking down from the bald thug's grinning face to his worn leather boots on the muddy flagstones.
EP15:E16 12600-14900 BALD THUG: "They look like weeds to me."
EP15:E17 13100-15100 ACTION: The bald thug flings the bouquet into the mud and grinds his heavy boot directly onto the delicate flowers.
EP15:E18 15100-19400 CAMERA: High-angle two-shot as Juliana rushes forward and drops directly onto her knees in the cold mud before the thug.
EP15:E19 15400-19100 ACTION: Juliana frantically tries to scoop the crushed soil and torn stems back into the bed with her bandaged hands.
EP15:E20 15800-18900 JULIANA: "Please! Those plants took months to grow!"
EP15:E21 19400-24100 CAMERA: Medium two-shot of the Tall Thug with the club and the Thug with Cap bursting into raucous laughter under the full moon.
EP15:E22 20100-23800 TALL THUG: "Months? You actually spend your days growing this filth?"
EP15:E23 24100-26600 CAMERA: Tight close-up of Juliana's bandaged hands trembling as she tenderly gathers the soiled white flowers from the puddles.
EP15:E24 26600-29600 CAMERA: Low-angle medium shot tilting up as Juliana rises from the ground, standing tall despite her trembling frame.
EP15:E25 27400-29400 JULIANA: "Leave my garden alone."
EP15:E26 29600-33100 CAMERA: Medium close-up of the Thug with Cap scoffing derisively.
EP15:E27 29800-33000 THUG WITH CAP: "A noble lady playing in the dirt. What a joke."
EP15:E28 33100-36800 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana, her eyes blazing with indignation and wounded pride.
EP15:E29 33600-36600 JULIANA: "It is my home. You have no right to destroy anything here."
EP15:E30 36800-39100 CAMERA: Tight close-up of the Thug with Cap stepping aggressively into Juliana's personal space, snarling with venom.
EP15:E31 37400-39000 THUG WITH CAP: "Get out of the way!"
EP15:E33 39100-39900 JULIANA: "No."
EP15:E32 39100-40600 CAMERA: Extreme close-up on Juliana's piercing blue eyes and set jaw, unflinching.
EP15:E34 40000-42100 ACTION: The Thug with Cap violently shoves Juliana back with both hands; she cries out as she loses her balance and crashes hard onto the wet stone path.
EP15:E35 40400-41600 JULIANA: "Ah!"
EP15:E36 42100-46100 CAMERA: Close-up tracking down to Juliana's hand hitting the mud next to the crushed chamomile flowers.
EP15:E37 42600-46100 ACTION: Juliana crawls forward on her elbows; fresh crimson blood seeps profusely through her white gauze bandages as she reaches for the ruined blossoms.
EP15:E39 46100-48300 JULIANA: "My mother's plants..."
EP15:E38 46100-49100 CAMERA: Tight close-up on Juliana's mud-streaked, tear-stained face trembling in heartbreaking agony.
EP15:E40 49100-52600 CAMERA: Low-angle wide shot of the three thugs pointing and laughing hysterically at her kneeling form.
EP15:E41 49900-52400 BALD THUG: "Look at her! Crying over weeds!"
EP15:E43 52600-53600 JULIANA: "Stop!"
EP15:E42 52600-54600 ACTION: The Tall Thug hoists his heavy wooden club above his head to crush the remaining herbs right before Juliana.
EP15:E44 54600-55800 CAMERA: Medium close-up of the Thug with Cap suddenly stiffening, his smug smile dropping as footsteps pound in the darkness.

EP20:E50 0-200 CAMERA: Medium two-shot of Juliana and Seamus standing facing each other in the barn, the lantern casting a warm amber glow between them.

EP20:E10 0-1300 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Catherine raising the porcelain teacup to her lips, her expression turning sharp and dismissive.
EP20:E12 100-1400 CATHERINE: "I marry the Lord of Ashbury."
EP20:E13 1300-6800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Rupert striding toward the tea table, leaning forward with predatory conviction.

EP20:E24 15500-18100 CATHERINE: "How tragic. The slow, quiet decline."

SEGMENT 1 (playback order)
EP21:E3 0-1300 SOUND: A loud wooden slam as the heavy double barn doors violently fly open.
EP21:E4 100-5000 CAMERA: Wide shot framing the open doorway against the overcast daylight as Prudence, a young village girl in an apron, rushes inside, frantic and weeping.
EP21:E5 700-4500 PRUDENCE: "Lady Juliana! Please! You have to help me, Toby is dying!"
EP21:E6 4700-7000 ACTION: Lady Juliana hurries over, placing her bandaged hands reassuringly on Prudence's trembling shoulders.
EP21:E8 5000-7500 LADY JULIANA: "Oh dear. Breathe. Tell me what has happened."
EP21:E7 5000-7700 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Lady Juliana looking into Prudence's tearful face with compassionate urgency.
EP21:E10 7700-11500 PRUDENCE: "My little brother Toby... his chest is burning! He cannot breathe!"
EP21:E9 7700-11600 CAMERA: Close-up of Prudence weeping, clutching her hands to her chest in agony.
EP21:E12 11500-14700 LADY JULIANA: "Tell me what the apothecary said. Did he not give you medicine?"
EP21:E11 11600-14700 CAMERA: Close-up of Lady Juliana, her brow furrowing with concern.
EP21:E14 14700-18200 PRUDENCE: "He shut the door in my face because we have no silver!"
EP21:E13 14700-18300 CAMERA: Close-up of Prudence, her face twisted in bitter anguish as she gestures back toward the rain-soaked outdoors.
EP21:E15 18300-21500 CAMERA: Wide shot of Lady Juliana and Prudence facing each other inside the wooden barn, dust motes drifting in the pale light.
EP21:E16 18300-21800 PRUDENCE: "The manor doctor laughed! He said village boys are not worth his time!"
EP21:E17 21500-27300 CAMERA: Medium profile shot of Lady Juliana looking down at her bandaged hands, holding Prudence's hand with somber heartache.
EP21:E18 21600-23900 LADY JULIANA: "We have no clinic now."
EP21:E19 24000-27300 LADY JULIANA: "Our cottage is ashes. I have nothing left but this coltsfoot."

CANDIDATE=c_d6acd0dc511f0e96 DURATION_MS=39600
SEGMENT 1 (playback order)
EP21:E17 0-100 CAMERA: Medium profile shot of Lady Juliana looking down at her bandaged hands, holding Prudence's hand with somber heartache.
EP21:E20 200-2200 ACTION: Prudence drops desperately to her knees onto the hay-strewn barn floor, clasping her hands in tearful supplication.
EP21:E22 200-5000 PRUDENCE: "He is only seven! If you do not come, he will die! You are his only hope, Lady Juliana!"
EP21:E21 300-5000 CAMERA: High-angle looking down at Prudence kneeling before Lady Juliana, pleading upward.
EP21:E23 5000-8700 ACTION: Lady Juliana immediately reaches down and pulls Prudence firmly back to her feet, then turns to snatch her heavy leather-bound herbal ledger from the wooden workbench.
EP21:E25 5100-9600 LADY JULIANA: "Stand up. Sinking to your knees will not save him. Let me grab my ledger. We go now."
EP21:E24 5100-9700 CAMERA: Medium shot framing the barn entrance as Lady Juliana lifts Prudence up, grabs her book, and leads the way out.
EP21:E26 9700-12000 CAMERA: Tracking wide shot following Lady Juliana and Prudence running side by side along a muddy, puddled village road past thatched stone cottages under a gloomy, overcast sky.
EP21:E27 9700-12000 ACTION: Lady Juliana clutches the thick book to her chest as she and Prudence sprint swiftly through the village.
EP21:E28 12000-14700 CAMERA: Low-angle medium shot of seven-year-old Toby lying on a makeshift straw pallet before a roaring fireplace, coughing weakly.
EP21:E29 12000-14700 SOUND: Heavy, raspy chest coughs echoing in the small room, accompanied by crackling hearth fire.
EP21:E30 14700-17200 ACTION: Lady Juliana rushes in, sets the ledger on the rustic wooden table, and quickly flips open the pages.
EP21:E31 14700-17700 CAMERA: Close-up of Lady Juliana rapidly scanning the botanical illustrations and handwritten remedies in the book.
EP21:E32 16500-18000 LADY JULIANA: "His skin is burning hot."
EP21:E33 18000-19700 ACTION: Lady Juliana places her bandaged hand against Toby's flushed, sweating forehead as he wheezes painfully.
EP21:E34 18000-20400 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Lady Juliana tending to Toby, with Prudence standing anxiously in the background.
EP21:E35 18100-20000 LADY JULIANA: "Prudence, fetch hot water immediately!"
EP21:E37 20400-22200 PRUDENCE: "Yes! Right away, I will get it!"
EP21:E36 20400-23200 CAMERA: Medium shot of Prudence nodding rapidly, rushing toward the stone hearth.
EP21:E38 22200-24200 ACTION: Prudence wraps a cloth around the iron handle of the steaming kettle resting over the hearth fire and lifts it.
EP21:E39 23200-25400 CAMERA: Close-up top-down view of Lady Juliana's bandaged fingers gently touching an ink illustration of chamomile flowers in the open ledger.
EP21:E40 23300-27400 LADY JULIANA: "I cannot let my own weariness stop me. This boy needs my mother's knowledge."
EP21:E41 27400-29700 ACTION: Lady Juliana crushes dried herbal leaves into a dark wooden bowl between her bandaged hands, then pours steaming water over them from the kettle.
EP21:E42 27700-30000 CAMERA: Close-up of hot water pouring into the bowl, releasing aromatic vapors from the dried herbs.
EP21:E43 30000-33200 ACTION: Lady Juliana sits beside the pallet and brings the steaming herbal bowl close to Toby's face while Prudence cradles his shoulders.
EP21:E44 30000-33700 CAMERA: Medium shot of Lady Juliana, Prudence, and Toby huddled together by the warm glow of the fire.
EP21:E45 30200-33200 LADY JULIANA: "Lift his shoulders, Prudence. Hold the steam close. Let him inhale."
EP21:E47 33700-35800 PRUDENCE: "Like this? Toby, breathe it in, sweet boy."
EP21:E46 33700-36000 CAMERA: Close-up of Prudence supporting Toby's head, whispering tenderly into his ear.
EP21:E49 36000-39600 LADY JULIANA: "Yes, just like that. Keep breathing, Toby. Let the vapor clear your chest."
EP21:E48 36000-39600 CAMERA: Close-up of Lady Juliana gently waving her hand to direct the medicinal steam toward Toby's nose and mouth.

SEGMENT 1 (playback order)
EP21:E28 0-2700 CAMERA: Low-angle medium shot of seven-year-old Toby lying on a makeshift straw pallet before a roaring fireplace, coughing weakly.
EP21:E29 0-2700 SOUND: Heavy, raspy chest coughs echoing in the small room, accompanied by crackling hearth fire.
EP21:E30 2700-5200 ACTION: Lady Juliana rushes in, sets the ledger on the rustic wooden table, and quickly flips open the pages.
EP21:E31 2700-5700 CAMERA: Close-up of Lady Juliana rapidly scanning the botanical illustrations and handwritten remedies in the book.
EP21:E32 4500-6000 LADY JULIANA: "His skin is burning hot."
EP21:E33 6000-7700 ACTION: Lady Juliana places her bandaged hand against Toby's flushed, sweating forehead as he wheezes painfully.
EP21:E34 6000-8400 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Lady Juliana tending to Toby, with Prudence standing anxiously in the background.
EP21:E35 6100-8000 LADY JULIANA: "Prudence, fetch hot water immediately!"
EP21:E37 8400-10200 PRUDENCE: "Yes! Right away, I will get it!"
EP21:E36 8400-11200 CAMERA: Medium shot of Prudence nodding rapidly, rushing toward the stone hearth.
EP21:E38 10200-12200 ACTION: Prudence wraps a cloth around the iron handle of the steaming kettle resting over the hearth fire and lifts it.
EP21:E39 11200-13400 CAMERA: Close-up top-down view of Lady Juliana's bandaged fingers gently touching an ink illustration of chamomile flowers in the open ledger.
EP21:E40 11300-15400 LADY JULIANA: "I cannot let my own weariness stop me. This boy needs my mother's knowledge."
EP21:E41 15400-17700 ACTION: Lady Juliana crushes dried herbal leaves into a dark wooden bowl between her bandaged hands, then pours steaming water over them from the kettle.
EP21:E42 15700-18000 CAMERA: Close-up of hot water pouring into the bowl, releasing aromatic vapors from the dried herbs.
EP21:E43 18000-21200 ACTION: Lady Juliana sits beside the pallet and brings the steaming herbal bowl close to Toby's face while Prudence cradles his shoulders.
EP21:E44 18000-21200 CAMERA: Medium shot of Lady Juliana, Prudence, and Toby huddled together by the warm glow of the fire.
EP21:E45 18200-21200 LADY JULIANA: "Lift his shoulders, Prudence. Hold the steam close. Let him inhale."

CANDIDATE=c_5fd693cb18637eea DURATION_MS=36500
SEGMENT 1 (playback order)
EP22:E55 0-1500 ACTION: Lady Juliana stops in her tracks and gazes upward in awe at the soaring gilded ceilings and aristocratic crest.
EP22:E56 0-1500 CAMERA: Low-angle push-in on Lady Juliana looking up at the enormous portrait of the late Duke and Duchess hanging above the gallery.
EP22:E57 0-1500 LADY JULIANA: "This house..."
EP22:E58 1500-4000 ACTION: Prudence rushes into frame, grabbing Juliana's arm to keep her moving.
EP22:E60 1500-4000 PRUDENCE: "Do not stare. Keep walking."
EP22:E59 1500-4300 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Prudence whispering frantically into Juliana's ear.
EP22:E61 4300-7500 CAMERA: Wide tracking shot behind Lady Juliana as she hastens down the long marble gallery toward the secluded West Wing wing.
EP22:E62 7500-11000 CAMERA: Medium shot of Lady Juliana standing outside a massive carved mahogany door, glancing around the empty hallway to ensure she is unobserved.
EP22:E63 11000-14000 ACTION: Lady Juliana reaches out with a trembling hand and quietly turns the ornate brass and glass door knob.
EP22:E64 11000-14000 CAMERA: Close-up of Lady Juliana's hand twisting the latch handle.
EP22:E65 12000-14000 SOUND: Faint, muffled click of the heavy door lock turning.
EP22:E66 14000-19300 CAMERA: Slow tracking shot into the cavernous, shadowy bedchamber. In the center stands an ornate four-poster canopy bed draped in pale silk where a frail, silver-haired figure lies motionless.
EP22:E67 14500-19500 SOUND: Labored, raspy, shallow breathing echoing in the quiet room.
EP22:E68 19300-21500 ACTION: Lady Juliana hurries inside, sets the wooden bucket onto the floor, and rushes to the bedside.
EP22:E69 19500-21000 LADY JULIANA: "Your Grace?"
EP22:E70 21000-23700 CAMERA: Close-up of the Dowager Duchess lying propped on pillows, her face gaunt, ashen, and drenched in cold sweat, her eyes half-fluttering.
EP22:E72 23700-25300 LADY JULIANA: "Do not speak."
EP22:E71 23700-26300 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Lady Juliana taking the Duchess's fragile, cold hands into her own.
EP22:E73 26300-31000 CAMERA: Close-up of Lady Juliana checking the Duchess's pulse and gently pressing her fingertips against the Duchess's chest and neck, her herbalist instincts taking over.
EP22:E74 28500-31300 ACTION: Lady Juliana's eyes widen with sudden, horrifying realization.
EP22:E75 29000-31300 LADY JULIANA: "This isn't ordinary fever."
EP22:E76 31300-32500 ACTION: The Dowager Duchess suddenly gasps violently for breath, convulsing weakly as her eyes snap open in agony.
EP22:E77 31300-32500 CAMERA: Close-up of the Duchess gasping in sudden spasms.
EP22:E78 32500-34300 CAMERA: Intense two-shot as Lady Juliana leans in close, gripping the Duchess's shoulder with urgent desperation.
EP22:E79 32700-34300 LADY JULIANA: "Who has been treating you?"
EP22:E80 34300-36500 CAMERA: Extreme close-up on the Dowager Duchess's terrified, wide eyes staring up as she chokes for air, the haunting realization of poison lingering as dramatic music hits an abrupt, suspenseful cliffhanger.

EP22:E39 0-400 CAMERA: Cut back to Lady Juliana maintaining her meek posture.

EP24:E9 0-400 CAMERA: Medium shot of the noblewoman, her chin tilted up in icy condescension.

EP24:E17 6100-10100 NOBLEWOMAN: "You thought? A new maid thinks she knows better than the physicians?"

EP24:E18 10400-12400 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana's resolute expression, her eyes flashing with righteous urgency.
EP24:E19 10600-12200 LADY JULIANA: "She is suffering."
EP24:E20 12400-14400 CAMERA: Tight close-up of the noblewoman's face twisting into a malicious sneer.

EP24:E24 16100-18100 ACTION: The noblewoman suddenly rears back her riding crop and strikes Juliana violently across the torso.
EP24:E25 16400-17400 SOUND: A sharp, stinging whip crack as the riding crop makes harsh contact.

EP24:E35 29100-31600 CAMERA: Medium shot of the noblewoman turning the crop in her white-gloved hands with smug satisfaction.

EP24:E39 0-2000 ACTION: Juliana's boots step down into a dark, rustic chamber dominated by an enormous, blackened stone hearth.

EP24:E61 23500-26500 NOBLEWOMAN: "That is where clever little servants belong."

CANDIDATE=c_40712e74bb5c3fa0 DURATION_MS=57400
SEGMENT 1 (playback order)
EP26:E11 0-100 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of the Duchess taking drops of the dark liquid from the glass bottle onto her lips.
EP26:E13 100-2400 CAMERA: Medium two-shot as Juliana withdraws the medicine bottle, standing beside the bedside lamp.
EP26:E15 2400-7100 DOWAGER DUCHESS: "You... you are no common servant. You took Catherine's whip for me the other day."
EP26:E14 2400-7400 CAMERA: Close-up of the Dowager Duchess observing Juliana with faint recognition through her exhaustion.
EP26:E16 7400-11800 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana, her eyes reflecting quiet resolve and pain.
EP26:E17 7600-11400 JULIANA: "I did what I had to. It does not change my duty."
EP26:E18 11800-14800 CAMERA: Medium two-shot as Juliana leans closer to tuck the blankets securely over the Duchess.
EP26:E19 11900-14600 JULIANA: "Rest now, Your Grace. You are safe tonight."
EP26:E20 14800-19100 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking around the shadowy room, her voice dropping to a tense whisper.
EP26:E21 15100-18600 JULIANA: "If the guards hear us, we are both dead."
EP26:E22 19100-22400 CAMERA: Static shot of the heavy carved double doors to the bedchamber, left slightly ajar with a sliver of hallway candlelight gleaming through the gap.
EP26:E23 22400-27400 CAMERA: Close-up of the Dowager Duchess lying back, processing Juliana's warning as dark realization settles into her face.
EP26:E24 24100-27100 ACTION: The Duchess clutches the blanket against her chest, her breathing quickening with dismay.
EP26:E25 27400-34100 CAMERA: Medium close-up of the Duchess looking upward toward Juliana, her voice trembling with tragic certainty.
EP26:E26 27600-33600 DOWAGER DUCHESS: "Rupert and Catherine want me dead. They are poisoning me in my own bed, aren't they?"
EP26:E27 34100-38600 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana leaning over the edge of the mattress, nodding earnestly to soothe her fears.
EP26:E28 34200-38300 JULIANA: "Yes. But the charcoal is fighting the poison. You are safe now."
EP26:E29 38600-43400 CAMERA: Close-up of the small amber dropper bottle sitting atop the polished wooden bedside table in the dim glow of the lamp.
EP26:E30 43400-51200 CAMERA: Medium shot of the Dowager Duchess looking intently at Juliana from her pillows, studying her bearing.
EP26:E31 45400-51000 DOWAGER DUCHESS: "Then tell me... why is a girl of such noble spirit working as a common maid?"
EP26:E32 51200-57400 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana, her chin lifting with dignified sorrow and quiet defiance.
EP26:E33 51600-57400 JULIANA: "Because my family cast me out to rot. I have nothing left in this world but my honor."

SEGMENT 1 (playback order)
EP30:E4 0-700 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Rupert standing nervously beside ornate double doors, wearing black gloves and an embroidered dark coat, glancing up with anxiety.
EP30:E5 0-1100 SOUND: A firm tap of the wooden walking stick halting against the floor.
EP30:E6 700-6700 CAMERA: Two-shot profile of the Elder Nobleman facing Rupert in the vaulted corridor.
EP30:E7 2000-6500 ELDER NOBLEMAN: "You have a rat in your cellar, Rupert. And the servants are beginning to smell it."
EP30:E8 6700-10100 CAMERA: Close-up of Rupert defensive and agitated.
EP30:E9 6800-10000 RUPERT: "The Ashcroft girl is locked tight. Nobody knows she is down there."
EP30:E10 10100-19200 CAMERA: Medium close-up of the Elder Nobleman fixing Rupert with a piercing, contemptuous glare.
EP30:E11 10500-19000 ELDER NOBLEMAN: "The kitchen maids are whispering. They see the soup bowls returned unwiped. They see your guards outside the lower grates."
EP30:E12 19200-23000 CAMERA: Medium shot of Rupert looking down, nervously pulling at his black leather gloves as dread creeps over his face.
EP30:E13 19700-22400 RUPERT: "She knows the Duchess was poisoned."
EP30:E14 23000-25200 CAMERA: Tight close-up on the Elder Nobleman's unyielding eyes narrowing in cold calculation.
EP30:E15 25200-26600 CAMERA: Tight close-up of Rupert swallows hard, breathless with dread.
EP30:E16 25300-26500 RUPERT: "If she speaks..."
EP30:E18 26600-28400 ACTION: The Elder Nobleman thrusts the gold knob of his walking stick directly against Rupert's chest, pinning him against the wall.
EP30:E17 26600-33000 CAMERA: Medium two-shot as the Elder Nobleman lunges forward aggressively, stepping into Rupert's personal space.
EP30:E19 26800-33000 ELDER NOBLEMAN: "Then make certain she isn't! A peasant weed, Rupert! You do not store weeds in your cellar, you burn them!"
EP30:E20 33000-37000 CAMERA: Low-angle close-up of Rupert gasping softly, intimidated by the cane pressed firmly beneath his cravat.
EP30:E21 35000-36700 RUPERT: "What are you suggesting?"
EP30:E22 37000-40500 CAMERA: Medium shot as the Elder Nobleman withdraws his cane and turns sharply toward the library doors.
EP30:E23 38000-40500 ELDER NOBLEMAN: "We stop hiding the prisoner."

CANDIDATE=c_303520ec62e3b718 DURATION_MS=58400
SEGMENT 1 (playback order)
EP31:E5 0-2600 CAMERA: Full shot framed through the arched doorway. Catherine stands imperiously in an ornate, gold-embroidered violet gown, holding a smoldering hot poker and a charred leather-bound book, flanked by two stone-faced guards with lanterns.
EP31:E6 0-1900 CATHERINE: "Look at you."
EP31:E7 2600-3600 CAMERA: Low-angle close-up of Juliana looking up from the stone floor, her gaze hardening despite her fear.
EP31:E8 3600-6900 CAMERA: Tight close-up of Catherine's face, bathed in the orange flickering glow of the red-hot branding iron, smiling with pure malice.
EP31:E9 3600-6900 CATHERINE: "The great Lady Juliana Ashcroft."
EP31:E10 6900-10700 CAMERA: Over-the-shoulder wide shot past Catherine looking down at Juliana shackled helplessly on the wet stone floor.
EP31:E11 7100-10700 CATHERINE: "Chained in a dungeon like a common criminal."
EP31:E12 10700-13900 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana, her eyes glistening with unshed tears, speaking with quiet defiance.
EP31:E13 10900-13600 JULIANA: "You seem very pleased."
EP31:E14 13900-17600 CAMERA: Low-angle shot looking up at Catherine towering over Juliana, holding the glowing poker at her side.
EP31:E15 14100-16600 CATHERINE: "I am."
EP31:E16 17600-22100 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of the bent, white-hot tip of the poker radiating heat, with Catherine's face blurred in the background as she gazes down with predatory pleasure.
EP31:E17 18100-22000 CATHERINE: "Because this is what you were always meant to be."
EP31:E18 22100-27900 CAMERA: Over-the-shoulder medium shot focusing on Juliana as Catherine presents the charred, singed pages of the botanical book.
EP31:E19 22400-27900 CATHERINE: "Your family dressed you like a lady. They educated you. They gave you a respectable name."
EP31:E20 27900-32100 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine's face breaking into an arrogant, haughty laugh.
EP31:E21 28100-32000 CATHERINE: "[chuckles] And still you became a disgrace."
EP31:E22 32100-36100 CAMERA: Tight close-up of Juliana's fierce, unwavering gaze as she retorts without hesitation.
EP31:E23 32300-36100 JULIANA: "I became a disgrace when I refused to become cruel."
EP31:E24 36100-41600 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine scowling, cutting back to a shot of Juliana's bare, chained feet locked in iron manacles against the cold stone floor.
EP31:E25 36300-41600 CATHERINE: "No. You became a disgrace when Gerald left you standing at the altar."
EP31:E26 41600-47900 CAMERA: Medium shot from floor level looking up at Catherine leaning closer, savoring Juliana's humiliation.
EP31:E27 42000-43900 CATHERINE: "Do you remember?"
EP31:E28 42100-45100 ACTION: Juliana stares up, her breathing steadying as she refuses to break under Catherine's barbs.
EP31:E29 44100-47900 CATHERINE: "Everyone saw you. Everyone watched him chose Clarisse."
EP31:E30 47900-52100 CAMERA: Close-up of the red-hot iron hovering over the damp stone floor, rising steam and heat waves warping the air, before cutting to Catherine's gloating expression.
EP31:E31 48300-50600 SOUND: Faint sizzling and hissing as ambient moisture touches the scalding iron tip.
EP31:E32 48600-51900 CATHERINE: "And everyone watched you walk away alone."
EP31:E33 52100-58400 CAMERA: Close-up pushing in on Juliana's illuminated, dignified face.
EP31:E34 52300-54400 JULIANA: "Gerald chose money."
EP31:E35 54600-56600 JULIANA: "Clarissa chose a coward."
EP31:E36 56900-58400 JULIANA: "I chose myself."

SEGMENT 1 (playback order)
EP32:E9 0-300 CAMERA: Wide shot showing Juliana chained against the cold dungeon wall, small and restrained beneath Catherine's towering shadow.
EP32:E10 200-2600 CATHERINE: "...but now you are afraid."
EP32:E11 300-2800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine straightening up haughtily.
EP32:E12 2800-3800 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Juliana, her lips trembling in agonizing sorrow.
EP32:E13 3000-5600 CATHERINE: "Say goodbye to your mother."
EP32:E14 3800-5800 CAMERA: Low-angle shot of Catherine swinging the flaming orange iron upward from the book.
EP32:E15 5600-7300 ACTION: Juliana's despair suddenly solidifies. Her jaw tightens, tears stopping as resolve takes over.
EP32:E16 5800-7300 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking up directly at Catherine, fear replaced by cold conviction.
EP32:E17 7000-8800 JULIANA: "Burn it."
EP32:E18 7300-9800 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana, sitting upright despite her heavy iron shackles.
EP32:E19 9800-12300 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine, her smug expression abruptly flickering with startled confusion.

EP32:E34 30200-32200 CATHERINE: "You still think you are better?!"

CANDIDATE=c_e81bed24a80a87bc DURATION_MS=41600
SEGMENT 1 (playback order)
EP32:E54 0-2100 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Catherine's face contorting in sheer fury.
EP32:E55 100-2000 CATHERINE: "You were rejected!"
EP32:E56 2100-4300 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana's calm, resolute face.
EP32:E57 2200-6400 JULIANA: "I was freed. And I found a man who never asked me what I was worth."
EP32:E58 4300-6300 CAMERA: Wide shot of the cell, steam rising faintly in the cold subterranean air.
EP32:E59 6300-8800 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine sneering with dripping condescension.
EP32:E60 6600-8200 CATHERINE: "Your soldier?"
EP32:E61 8800-11300 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana, her eyes glowing with genuine devotion.
EP32:E62 9000-10800 JULIANA: "My husband."
EP32:E64 11300-12800 CATHERINE: "He is a nobody."
EP32:E63 11300-12900 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine scowling with deep disgust.
EP32:E65 12900-15300 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana smiling softly, totally untroubled.
EP32:E66 13000-15000 JULIANA: "Then I love a nobody."
EP32:E67 15300-18600 CAMERA: Low-angle shot focusing on Juliana's bare, chained feet locked in iron on the stone floor.
EP32:E68 15300-19000 JULIANA: "Because that nobody showed me more love than your entire world ever did."
EP32:E69 18600-21600 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Catherine gripping the branding rod tighter, her upper lip curling in fury.
EP32:E70 18900-21400 CATHERINE: "You know nothing about my world."
EP32:E71 21600-25800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana sitting in her tattered apron and chains, looking composed.
EP32:E72 22000-25400 JULIANA: "I know exactly what your world values."
EP32:E73 25800-28600 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Juliana's lips and eyes as she lists them with chilling precision.
EP32:E74 26400-28400 JULIANA: "Beauty. Money."
EP32:E75 28600-29800 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Catherine's wide, stunned eyes reacting to the naked truth.
EP32:E76 29800-32500 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking up unflinchingly.
EP32:E77 30000-32300 JULIANA: "Family. A perfect name."
EP32:E78 32500-35800 CAMERA: Low-angle shot of Catherine standing rigid in her gold and purple gown, the guard standing sentinel behind her.
EP32:E79 32600-36000 JULIANA: "And a woman who never embarrasses the people standing behind her."
EP32:E80 35800-37600 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine throwing her hands up in explosive defensiveness.
EP32:E81 36000-37600 CATHERINE: "And what is wrong with that?!"
EP32:E82 37600-38200 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine's face twisting in absolute venom.
EP32:E83 38200-41300 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana looking serene.
EP32:E84 38300-41600 JULIANA: "Nothing. Until you have nothing left beneath it."
EP32:E85 41300-41600 CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine standing motionless, holding the iron rod, struck to the core by the insult.

SEGMENT 1 (playback order)
EP34:E1 0-2800 CAMERA: High wide establishing shot from behind the presiding judge looking down into the grand, sunlit courtroom filled with stern spectators, armed bailiffs, and Lady Juliana standing confined in the wooden prisoner's dock on the left.
EP34:E2 1200-7800 JUDGE: "Lady Juliana Ashcroft, you are accused of witchcraft, unlawful healing, and poisoning."
EP34:E3 2800-7800 CAMERA: Medium close-up of the stern, elderly Judge seated at the high mahogany bench, resting both hands on the court documents.
EP34:E4 7800-13100 CAMERA: Close-up of the charred, ancient botanical grimoire resting on the bench, its scorched pages open to an illustration of a wild rose, as a finger firmly taps the text.
EP34:E5 9000-11200 SOUND: [A firm, hollow tap of a finger striking the parchment]
EP34:E6 9100-12600 JUDGE: "Do you deny possessing this book?"
EP34:E7 13100-15500 CAMERA: Low-angle medium close-up of Lady Juliana standing erect in the dock, her prisoner label pinned to her rustic buttoned gown, her expression resolute.
EP34:E8 13800-14800 LADY JULIANA: "No."
EP34:E9 15500-19400 CAMERA: Low-angle medium shot of the Judge leaning over his elevated bench, staring down critically.
EP34:E10 15600-19200 JUDGE: "Do you deny using its remedies?"
EP34:E11 19400-23800 CAMERA: Tight close-up of Lady Juliana's face, bruised cheekbone highlighting her calm defiance.
EP34:E12 20800-21800 LADY JULIANA: "No."
EP34:E13 23800-27400 CAMERA: Medium shot of the aristocratic Lord standing at the railing in his tailored dark coat, turning slowly with a smirk of malicious satisfaction.
EP34:E14 27400-31700 CAMERA: Close-up of the Judge leaning forward across his bench, eyes narrowing with grim conviction.
EP34:E15 27500-31200 JUDGE: "Then you admit to practicing forbidden arts."
EP34:E16 31700-35300 CAMERA: Close-up of Lady Juliana looking upward with quiet dignity, her eyes luminous.
EP34:E17 33200-35100 LADY JULIANA: "I admit to healing the sick."
EP34:E18 35300-37400 ACTION: The Judge furiously raises his wooden gavel and strikes the sound block with sharp force.
EP34:E19 35400-36600 JUDGE: "Silence!"
EP34:E20 35800-37000 SOUND: [Sharp, echoing crack of the gavel slamming onto wood]
EP34:E21 35800-37400 CAMERA: Medium shot of the Judge slamming the gavel down on his bench.
EP34:E22 37400-41200 CAMERA: Tracking shot moving from the Judge on his bench as he points his outstretched arm across the courtroom floor toward the witness stand.
EP34:E23 37500-41200 JUDGE: "Prudence. You served beside the accused?"
EP34:E24 41000-41200 ACTION: Prudence the young maid stands trembling in the center of the courtroom floor, her head bowed in deep shame, clutching the sides of her apron.

SEGMENT 1 (playback order)
EP41:E3 0-1000 CATHERINE: "Wait."
EP41:E2 0-2700 ACTION: Catherine abruptly pulls away from Rupert and raises her white-gloved hand high, commanding silence from the congregation.
EP41:E4 2700-6700 CAMERA: Medium shot tracking Catherine as she pivots toward the seated aristocracy, her veil floating gracefully behind her.
EP41:E5 3100-6400 CATHERINE: "Before I become Duchess of Ashburgh..."
EP41:E7 6700-10900 CATHERINE: "...I want everyone to see what happens to a woman who dares defy this family."
EP41:E6 6700-11200 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine's face, her lips curling into a sadistic, triumphant sneer.
EP41:E8 11200-13700 CAMERA: Two-shot profile of Rupert and Catherine. Rupert turns to her with mild caution.
EP41:E9 11400-12200 BLOND NOBLEMAN: "Catherine..."
EP41:E10 12200-13500 CATHERINE: "Bring her in."
EP41:E11 13700-15700 SOUND: Heavy wooden creak of the cathedral double doors swinging open.
EP41:E12 13700-18200 CAMERA: Wide shot from behind the altar down the aisle as the great church doors slowly open, revealing the silhouette of three figures against the daylight.
EP41:E13 15700-18200 ACTION: Juliana, dressed in a coarse drab prison dress with a numbered identification badge, is marched forward by two armed constables holding her by the arms.
EP41:E14 18200-21000 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Juliana's scarred, dirtied wrists bound tight in heavy iron shackles.
EP41:E15 21000-24200 CAMERA: Intense close-up of Juliana's bruised, dirt-streaked face. Her piercing blue eyes burn with fierce dignity despite her captive state.
EP41:E16 24200-27000 CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine standing beside the altar, watching Juliana's entrance with gloating satisfaction.
EP41:E17 25000-26600 CATHERINE: "There she is."
EP41:E18 27000-28200 CAMERA: Medium tracking shot of Juliana marching between the stern constables down the central aisle toward the altar.
EP41:E19 28200-32200 CAMERA: Medium shot of a seated aristocratic couple in the pews, whispering and sneering behind an ivory lace fan.
EP41:E20 28700-29800 NOBLEWOMAN: "Look at her."
EP41:E21 29900-32000 NOBLEMAN: "She actually came back to the chapel."
EP41:E22 32200-35000 CAMERA: Close-up of the noblewoman giggling with hand over mouth, glancing spitefully at the disgraced bride.
EP41:E23 33000-35000 NOBLEWOMAN: "Not as a bride this time."
EP41:E24 35000-38000 CAMERA: Medium shot of two senior aristocrats in the carved choir stalls, resting on their canes and nodding in smug agreement.
EP41:E25 38000-42000 CAMERA: Close profile of Juliana as she halts in the center aisle, lifting her chin proudly to face the sneering onlookers.
EP41:E26 39200-42400 CATHERINE: "Lady Juliana Ashcroft. Look around."
EP41:E27 42000-46700 CAMERA: High-angle wide shot showing Juliana flanked by guards in the center of the lavishly decorated nave, dwarfed by the grand cathedral.
EP41:E28 43200-46200 CATHERINE: "This is the world you thought you belonged to."
EP41:E29 46700-51000 CAMERA: Low-angle medium shot of Catherine gesturing broadly from the altar steps, looking down upon Juliana like an empress.
EP41:E30 46800-50600 CATHERINE: "And now they can all see what you truly are."
EP41:E31 51000-56000 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana standing firmly between the guards, calmly meeting Catherine's venomous gaze.
EP41:E32 53000-55700 ACTION: Juliana looks around the cathedral at the sea of pompous faces, then raises her eyes straight back to Catherine with utter disdain.
EP41:E33 56000-58700 CAMERA: Tight close-up on Juliana's bruised, unshaken face.
EP41:E34 56200-58700 JULIANA: "You needed an entire chapel to feel powerful over one chained woman?"

CANDIDATE=c_f05bb9c9fcff10a8 DURATION_MS=28900
SEGMENT 1 (playback order)
EP45:E36 0-300 CAMERA: Medium shot as Alexander turns back toward the altar, where Catherine stands in her disheveled wedding gown.
EP45:E39 300-6700 CAMERA: Medium shot as Alexander steps right up to Catherine, towering over her with righteous fury.
EP45:E40 2500-6500 ALEXANDER: "You poisoned my mother. You tortured my wife."
EP45:E42 6700-8300 CATHERINE: "I didn't know!"
EP45:E41 6700-11000 CAMERA: Extreme close-up split profile between Alexander's angry face and Catherine's gasping, terrified expression.
EP45:E43 8500-10900 ALEXANDER: "You knew exactly what you were doing!"
EP45:E44 11000-15500 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Alexander turning slightly toward the gathered congregation as his voice rings across the cathedral.
EP45:E45 11100-15300 ALEXANDER: "You hurt the two women who mattered most to me: my mother, and my wife."
EP45:E46 15500-19700 CAMERA: Close-up on Catherine's devastated, terrified face as the word shatters her entire worldview.
EP45:E47 17300-19000 CATHERINE: "Wife?!"
EP45:E48 19700-23000 CAMERA: Grand wide shot of the ruined cathedral nave as Alexander takes Juliana's hand and walks her proudly down the center aisle.
EP45:E49 19700-23000 ACTION: Alexander and Juliana advance side-by-side between the rows of shocked aristocratic guests.
EP45:E50 20000-22500 ALEXANDER: "Before the Crown and before God..."
EP45:E51 23000-28900 CAMERA: Medium shot as Alexander stops in the center of the nave and raises Juliana's hand high above their heads.
EP45:E52 23100-28500 ACTION: Alexander hoists Juliana's hand triumphantly into the air, presenting her to the nobility.
EP45:E53 23300-28900 ALEXANDER: "Lady Juliana Ashcroft is my lawful wife... and the Duchess of Ashburton!"

CANDIDATE=c_57e44812930bf2a2 DURATION_MS=26500
SEGMENT 1 (playback order)
EP45:E58 0-1700 SOUND: Loud, echoing thud of cathedral doors swinging open violently.
EP45:E57 0-4000 CAMERA: Wide tracking shot down the cathedral aisle as the massive wooden entrance doors slam open, framed by blinding daylight and mist.
EP45:E59 1000-4500 ACTION: A Catholic Bishop in dark vestments steps through the cathedral doors accompanied by an armed Crown officer.
EP45:E60 1900-4300 HIGH PRIEST: "No one will bow yet!"
EP45:E61 4300-6500 CAMERA: Low-angle shot on Alexander and Juliana turning in alarm toward the rear of the cathedral.
EP45:E62 6500-14700 CAMERA: Medium shot of the High Priest striding down the aisle, holding up an official royal parchment bearing red wax seals.
EP45:E63 6700-14500 ACTION: The Priest holds up the sealed royal proclamation, holding his rosary beads as he marches forward.
EP45:E64 6700-14600 HIGH PRIEST: "This ceremony was performed without a Crown marriage license, by a priest without authority to sanctify a ducal union."
EP45:E65 14700-19300 CAMERA: Close-up on the High Priest unfolding the document, reading aloud to the congregation.
EP45:E66 15000-19000 HIGH PRIEST: "These vows were never entered into the Royal Matrimonial Register."
EP45:E67 19300-22300 CAMERA: Medium shot of Alexander shielding Juliana behind him as the Crown officer approaches with drawn sword.
EP45:E68 19700-22300 HIGH PRIEST: "Before the Crown, you are not Duchess of Ashburton."
EP45:E69 22300-26500 CAMERA: Close-up of the High Priest scowling directly at Juliana with unyielding authority.
EP45:E70 22500-26500 HIGH PRIEST: "You are not Alexander Ashburton's lawful wife."

messages.content:
CANDIDATE=c_c229c54873e8c31a DURATION_MS=47000
SEGMENT 1 (playback order)
EP46:E7 0-2800 CAMERA: Medium shot of the High Priest holding up a wax-sealed document before his chest, flanked by two armed guards.
EP46:E8 500-5800 HIGH PRIEST: "By Royal command, this sanctuary is placed under immediate Crown scesion."
EP46:E9 2800-6200 CAMERA: Close-up of the High Priest's fingers breaking the crimson wax seal and string on the war office envelope.
EP46:E10 4000-5800 SOUND: Crisp tear of wax and parchment string snapping open.
EP46:E11 6200-9500 CAMERA: Low-angle medium shot of the High Priest opening the yellowed War Office document.
EP46:E12 6300-9400 HIGH PRIEST: "None shall leave until every witness is accounted for."
EP46:E13 9500-11800 CAMERA: Wide shot of Alexander and Juliana standing defiant at the altar as congregation members watch in silence.
EP46:E14 9600-11800 HIGH PRIEST: "You married this woman as a nameless beggar..."
EP46:E15 11800-15800 CAMERA: Medium close-up of the High Priest holding the decree, his gaze burning with disdain.
EP46:E16 11900-15500 HIGH PRIEST: "...in a hedge ceremony no clerk in England ever recorded."
EP46:E17 15800-19500 CAMERA: Full shot of the High Priest brandishing the letter aloft in the center of the chapel nave.
EP46:E18 15800-20800 HIGH PRIEST: "Three years later, the beggar is revealed to be a Duke. The marriage does not rise with him."
EP46:E19 19500-23200 CAMERA: Medium shot of Alexander turning toward Juliana, placing a protective hand on her arm.
EP46:E20 21500-23500 ACTION: Juliana places her hand over Alexander's as he steps forward to shield her.
EP46:E21 23200-26000 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander, his scarred face hardening with unwavering conviction.
EP46:E22 23300-25700 ALEXANDER: "She married the man... not the title."
EP46:E23 26000-31800 CAMERA: Low-angle shot looking up at the High Priest as he raises the parchment toward the vaulted ceiling.
EP46:E24 26300-31500 HIGH PRIEST: "The church married a vagrant to a ruined lady. It never married the Duke of Ashburton to anyone."
EP46:E25 31800-36000 CAMERA: Medium shot of the High Priest lowering the document, raising a single finger in admonishment.
EP46:E26 31800-36000 HIGH PRIEST: "No Crown license was sought, because no one thought to ask leave for a Duke to marry."
EP46:E27 36000-38000 CAMERA: Two-shot of Juliana and Alexander listening intently, Juliana's eyes flashing with hurt and defiance.
EP46:E28 36100-38000 HIGH PRIEST: "No licensed clergyman presided..."
EP46:E29 38000-41200 CAMERA: Close-up of the High Priest glaring intently.
EP46:E30 38000-41200 HIGH PRIEST: "...because a frightened village priest has no authority to bind a peer."
EP46:E32 41200-47000 HIGH PRIEST: "And no clerk in London ever entered your name in the Royal register, because as far as the Crown knew, Alexander Ashburton was already dead."
EP46:E31 41200-47000 CAMERA: Medium shot pushing into a close-up as the High Priest thrusts the royal War Office proclamation directly into the camera.

messages.content:
CANDIDATE=c_7f9ceb1d70f1ca0b DURATION_MS=27500
SEGMENT 1 (playback order)
EP46:E31 0-200 CAMERA: Medium shot pushing into a close-up as the High Priest thrusts the royal War Office proclamation directly into the camera.
EP46:E33 200-4800 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana lifting her chin, tearful yet burning with righteous fury.
EP46:E34 500-4500 JULIANA: "I didn't ask this church for permission to survive, Father."
EP46:E35 4800-7800 CAMERA: Medium two-shot of Juliana standing proudly beside Alexander.
EP46:E36 4900-7500 JULIANA: "I won't ask it for permission to love."
EP46:E37 7800-13000 CAMERA: Close-up of the High Priest looking down, a sinister, condescending smirk gracing his lips.
EP46:E38 8800-12500 HIGH PRIEST: "Love doesn't make a Duchess, girl. Paper does."
EP46:E39 13000-18800 CAMERA: Slow push-in medium close-up on Juliana, her voice trembling with intense indignation.
EP46:E40 13400-16300 JULIANA: "Then look at this floor honestly, for once."
EP46:E41 16400-18600 JULIANA: "A church called me unworthy."
EP46:E42 18800-20000 CAMERA: Quick cut to the High Priest maintaining a smug, impenetrable stare.
EP46:E43 18800-20000 JULIANA: "A church chained me."
EP46:E44 20000-27500 CAMERA: Extreme close-up on Juliana's face as she shouts at the priest.
EP46:E45 20100-23000 JULIANA: "Now a church calls my marriage a lie!"
EP46:E46 23100-27500 JULIANA: "God married us, Father! You are just angry no one asked you first!"

messages.content:
CANDIDATE=c_6303b16c81b3d238 DURATION_MS=38100
SEGMENT 1 (playback order)
EP46:E54 0-100 CAMERA: Wide shot of the High Priest waving the letter overhead before the congregation.
EP46:E56 100-1400 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine listening eagerly.
EP46:E58 1400-6100 ALEXANDER: "A Duke's marriage is judged by the Crown's peerage court, not by a parish priest's seal."
EP46:E57 1400-6400 CAMERA: Profile medium shot of Alexander confronting the High Priest face-to-face at the foot of the altar.
EP46:E59 6400-11400 CAMERA: Low-angle two-shot of the High Priest staring up into Alexander's imposing frame.
EP46:E60 6600-11100 HIGH PRIEST: "The High Religious Council rules on matters of holy matrimony. That includes yours."
EP46:E61 11400-18100 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Alexander glaring with icy authority.
EP46:E62 11600-17800 ALEXANDER: "Then let it prove that in ten days, before witnesses. Not with six halberds pointed at me in my own chapel."
EP46:E63 18100-23600 CAMERA: Wide profile two-shot of the High Priest and Alexander locked in an intense standoff before the altar.
EP46:E64 18400-23200 HIGH PRIEST: "Ten days. And if the council rules against you, this county watches you lose her twice."
EP46:E65 23600-26100 ALEXANDER: "I'll take that wager over your decree."
EP46:E66 26100-26800 CAMERA: Quick reaction shot of the elderly woman in the pew gripping her beads in distress.
EP46:E68 26800-32800 ALEXANDER: "Lower them! Or explain to the Crown why its own bailiffs raised iron on the Duke it just confirmed!"
EP46:E67 26800-33100 CAMERA: Wide shot from behind the guards as they surround Alexander and Juliana, halberds and swords pointed inches from Alexander's chest.
EP46:E69 33100-38100 CAMERA: Medium shot of the High Priest extending his hand toward the guards, commanding them to stand down.
EP46:E70 33600-35600 ACTION: The guards slowly lower their weapon points away from the Duke.
EP46:E71 33800-38100 HIGH PRIEST: "Ten days, Duke. Choose your witnesses well."

messages.content:
CANDIDATE=c_f632d2f70718a188 DURATION_MS=37500
SEGMENT 1 (playback order)
EP46:E47 0-200 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Catherine leaning against a stone archway, whispering with venomous mockery.
EP46:E49 200-3500 CAMERA: Close-up of the High Priest pressing the document against his chest, his eyes darkening with anger.
EP46:E50 300-3400 HIGH PRIEST: "Careful, girl. You mistake my patience for weakness."
EP46:E52 3200-7200 HIGH PRIEST: "God did not marry you. A frightened parishioner did, without leave, without license, without the Crown's blessing!"
EP46:E51 3500-7000 CAMERA: Low-angle shot of the High Priest stepping up the altar steps toward them.
EP46:E53 7000-7800 CAMERA: Brief insert of Catherine smirking as she watches from the side.
EP46:E55 7800-11400 HIGH PRIEST: "And I have the power to undo in one hearing what took you three years to steal!"
EP46:E54 7800-11500 CAMERA: Wide shot of the High Priest waving the letter overhead before the congregation.
EP46:E56 11500-12800 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine listening eagerly.
EP46:E58 12800-17500 ALEXANDER: "A Duke's marriage is judged by the Crown's peerage court, not by a parish priest's seal."
EP46:E57 12800-17800 CAMERA: Profile medium shot of Alexander confronting the High Priest face-to-face at the foot of the altar.
EP46:E59 17800-22800 CAMERA: Low-angle two-shot of the High Priest staring up into Alexander's imposing frame.
EP46:E60 18000-22500 HIGH PRIEST: "The High Religious Council rules on matters of holy matrimony. That includes yours."
EP46:E61 22800-29500 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Alexander glaring with icy authority.
EP46:E62 23000-29200 ALEXANDER: "Then let it prove that in ten days, before witnesses. Not with six halberds pointed at me in my own chapel."
EP46:E63 29500-35000 CAMERA: Wide profile two-shot of the High Priest and Alexander locked in an intense standoff before the altar.
EP46:E64 29800-34600 HIGH PRIEST: "Ten days. And if the council rules against you, this county watches you lose her twice."
EP46:E65 35000-37500 ALEXANDER: "I'll take that wager over your decree."

CANDIDATE=c_ba4503fd4f1cb104 DURATION_MS=32200
SEGMENT 1 (playback order)
EP47:E50 500-3800 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine's face turning from despair to offended shock.
EP47:E51 1000-3800 CATHERINE: "You want me? As a guest?"
EP47:E52 3800-6200 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana staring straight into Catherine's eyes without blinking.
EP47:E53 4200-6000 JULIANA: "As a scullery maid."
EP47:E54 6200-9800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine recoiling in disgust, looking around at the gathered estate retainers.
EP47:E55 6500-9500 CATHERINE: "You expect me to scrub floors before these commoners?"
EP47:E56 9800-13500 CAMERA: Dramatic profile two-shot of Juliana standing inches away from Catherine, dominating the confrontation.
EP47:E57 10200-13500 JULIANA: "You will scrub the floors you walked on as an impostor."
EP47:E58 13500-16500 CAMERA: Juliana extends the ring of iron keys outward in her fist.
EP47:E59 13800-16500 JULIANA: "You will scrub the manor hearths at dawn."
EP47:E60 16500-19500 CAMERA: Close profile two-shot of the two women locked in an intense psychological battle.
EP47:E61 16800-19500 JULIANA: "You will scour the kitchen grease until midnight."
EP47:E62 19500-23500 CAMERA: Juliana presents the rough hemp apron and heavy keys right to Catherine's face.
EP47:E63 19800-23500 JULIANA: "One complaint from the housekeeper, and you are cast out with nothing."
EP47:E64 23500-26800 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine's trembling lips, humiliated tears spilling down her heavily made-up cheeks.
EP47:E65 24200-26600 CATHERINE: "You humiliate me."
EP47:E66 26800-32200 CAMERA: Medium shot of both women standing beneath the cathedral vaulting of the hall.
EP47:E67 27200-32200 JULIANA: "I offer you bread and honest labor. Take the apron, or leave the county."

SEGMENT 1 (playback order)
EP47:E1 0-1800 CAMERA: Low-angle focus on a dripping candle burning on a wooden table beside a dark window looking out into the misty night.
EP47:E3 1800-8200 CATHERINE: "Rupert is rotting in the undercroft cells. Not me. I intend to stay on this estate."
EP47:E2 1800-8500 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Catherine in a lace nightgown and lilac robe, holding a goblet of red wine with cold determination.
EP47:E4 8500-14800 CAMERA: Two-shot framing Catherine in the background with a muscular, bare-chested conspirator standing in shadow beside her.
EP47:E5 8800-14500 CONSPIRATOR: "Alexander will scour the grounds at first light. The High Council has already blocked the marriage registry."
EP47:E6 14800-18300 CAMERA: Close-up profile of Catherine leaning close to the man's shoulder, her eyes burning with ambition.
EP47:E7 15000-18200 CATHERINE: "Then you will make sure I remain inside these walls."
EP47:E8 18300-21500 CAMERA: Silhouette shot against the tall arched window as Catherine turns her back to him.
EP47:E9 18500-21200 CATHERINE: "Keep the council paralyzed. I will do the rest."

EP47:E11 23200-26500 CAMERA: Medium shot of Alexander and Juliana sitting together on the edge of the velvet bed, dressed in morning robes.
EP47:E12 23400-26800 JULIANA: "What if Father Thomas sways the High Council?"
EP47:E13 26500-30300 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana's distressed face, tears shimmering in her eyes as she looks up at Alexander.
EP47:E14 27000-30300 JULIANA: "What if they strip your title? Because of me?"

CANDIDATE=c_cda128f4a321cbbe DURATION_MS=26500
SEGMENT 1 (playback order)
EP48:E2 0-3000 ACTION: Catherine, adorned in an ornate dark burgundy gown with braided golden hair, gazes out the dark window before turning slowly with a cold, venomous smirk.
EP48:E1 0-4500 CAMERA: Medium shot tracking slightly as Catherine stands beside a tall mullioned stone window, silhouetted against the moonlight over the distant castle spires.
EP48:E3 2400-7500 CATHERINE: "Two words, and that healer's crown rolls right back into the gutter where it belongs."
EP48:E4 4500-8500 CAMERA: Close-up on Catherine's profile and jewelry as she speaks with calculating contempt.
EP48:E5 7800-12300 ACTION: Catherine glides across the chamber past a roaring stone hearth, picking up an orange from a silver platter on the table.
EP48:E6 8000-12300 CATHERINE: "Ten days. He gave himself ten days to fix it."
EP48:E7 12300-20000 CAMERA: Medium close-up frontal shot of Catherine turning directly toward the viewer, her expression tightening into ruthless determination.
EP48:E8 12600-14900 CATHERINE: "Ten days for the council to sit."
EP48:E9 15000-18500 ACTION: Catherine raises a gloved index finger, emphasizing each point with sinister precision.
EP48:E10 15100-17200 CATHERINE: "Ten days for witnesses to be gathered."
EP48:E11 17400-19700 CATHERINE: "Ten days for a decree to be undone."
EP48:E12 20000-26500 CAMERA: Slight push-in on Catherine as she clenches her fist against her chest, her eyes blazing with malice.
EP48:E13 20100-23700 CATHERINE: "Ten days is not a wall, Alexander. It's a door."
EP48:E14 23900-26500 CATHERINE: "And doors can be closed from the other side."

CANDIDATE=c_14f0ab5a715e28e0 DURATION_MS=38500
SEGMENT 1 (playback order)
EP48:E19 0-1900 CAMERA: Close-up on Agnes's hands turning the ornate iron key in the wooden door's brass lock.
EP48:E20 300-1800 SOUND: Heavy metallic click of an iron key latching into a deadbolt.
EP48:E21 2000-4500 ACTION: Catherine strides forward and firmly grasps Agnes by both hands, stepping uncomfortably close.
EP48:E22 2000-11000 CAMERA: Two-shot profile of Catherine towering over Agnes in the candlelight.
EP48:E23 2200-5100 CATHERINE: "Everyone in that chapel saw me humiliated today."
EP48:E24 5300-7000 CATHERINE: "Good. Let them remember it."
EP48:E25 7200-11000 CATHERINE: "Grief makes people careless, and carelessness is exactly what I need from that household right now."
EP48:E26 11000-14800 CAMERA: Over-the-shoulder close-up on Agnes, her brow furrowed in anxious alarm.
EP48:E27 11300-14800 AGNES: "My lady... the Duke has bailiffs watching every road out of the county."
EP48:E28 14800-19500 CAMERA: Close-up on Catherine, a smug, venomous smile spreading across her painted lips.
EP48:E29 15000-19300 CATHERINE: "I'm not leaving the county, Agnes. I'm going back into that house."
EP48:E30 19500-26200 CAMERA: Medium tracking shot following Catherine as she releases Agnes and stalks across the room toward the window sill.
EP48:E31 20000-23000 CATHERINE: "Father Thomas did his part beautifully today."
EP48:E32 23200-26200 CATHERINE: "Now I need him to do a little more before that hearing convenes."
EP48:E33 26200-29000 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Agnes glancing nervously over her shoulder.
EP48:E34 26500-28600 AGNES: "If someone sees him come to you..."
EP48:E35 29000-34900 CAMERA: Close-up on Catherine spinning around from the window, her jaw set in terrifying firmness.
EP48:E36 29800-32000 CATHERINE: "Then no one sees him."
EP48:E37 32300-34900 CATHERINE: "That is precisely your job tonight."
EP48:E38 34900-38500 CAMERA: Medium shot as Catherine picks up a heavy velvet coin purse and places it firmly into Agnes's awaiting open palms.
EP48:E39 35500-37000 SOUND: Dull clinking of heavy gold coins inside a leather pouch.
EP48:E40 35800-38500 CATHERINE: "Send for the priest. Tonight."

CANDIDATE=c_377be08c2c58ecbd DURATION_MS=20000
SEGMENT 1 (playback order)
EP48:E2 0-3000 ACTION: Catherine, adorned in an ornate dark burgundy gown with braided golden hair, gazes out the dark window before turning slowly with a cold, venomous smirk.
EP48:E1 0-4500 CAMERA: Medium shot tracking slightly as Catherine stands beside a tall mullioned stone window, silhouetted against the moonlight over the distant castle spires.
EP48:E3 2400-7500 CATHERINE: "Two words, and that healer's crown rolls right back into the gutter where it belongs."
EP48:E4 4500-8500 CAMERA: Close-up on Catherine's profile and jewelry as she speaks with calculating contempt.
EP48:E5 7800-12300 ACTION: Catherine glides across the chamber past a roaring stone hearth, picking up an orange from a silver platter on the table.
EP48:E6 8000-12300 CATHERINE: "Ten days. He gave himself ten days to fix it."
EP48:E7 12300-20000 CAMERA: Medium close-up frontal shot of Catherine turning directly toward the viewer, her expression tightening into ruthless determination.
EP48:E8 12600-14900 CATHERINE: "Ten days for the council to sit."
EP48:E9 15000-18500 ACTION: Catherine raises a gloved index finger, emphasizing each point with sinister precision.
EP48:E10 15100-17200 CATHERINE: "Ten days for witnesses to be gathered."
EP48:E11 17400-19700 CATHERINE: "Ten days for a decree to be undone."

CANDIDATE=c_d8e479da24c0779f DURATION_MS=57000
SEGMENT 1 (playback order)
EP49:E7 0-300 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Father Thomas under his black hood, his stern face framed by the clerical collar and silver crucifix resting on his chest.
EP49:E9 300-4600 CAMERA: Close-up profile of Catherine, turning with a slight, knowing smirk.
EP49:E10 600-3600 CATHERINE: "Good. That's what I pay her for."
EP49:E11 4600-6800 CAMERA: Medium two-shot as Catherine steps forward and sets the heavy candleholder onto a small round table draped in grey cloth between them.
EP49:E12 4800-6800 ACTION: Catherine sets down the brass candleholder, the flame flickering across their faces.
EP49:E13 6800-12300 CAMERA: Tight close-up on Father Thomas's face, the candlelight dancing in his calculating eyes.
EP49:E14 7000-12000 FATHER THOMAS: "No shadows tonight, Catherine. Just us and an empty wing."
EP49:E15 12300-18000 CAMERA: Close-up on Catherine, her blonde ringlets peeking from beneath her velvet hood as she smiles faintly.
EP49:E16 12600-17800 CATHERINE: "You didn't need them the first time, either. I just prefer my secrets thorough."
EP49:E17 18000-26600 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Father Thomas, glancing down momentarily before fixing his piercing gaze back on her.
EP49:E18 18300-26300 FATHER THOMAS: "A priest and a disgraced bride meeting before dawn in her bedchamber. I'd say thoroughness served us both rather well."
EP49:E19 26600-31600 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine's face hardening into a stern, focused expression.
EP49:E20 26800-31300 CATHERINE: "It will keep serving us as long as neither of us gets careless. No one in this house so much as suspects your face belongs to that morning. Let's keep it that way."
EP49:E21 31600-33300 CAMERA: Close-up on Father Thomas listening impassively.
EP49:E22 33300-37800 CAMERA: Medium wide two-shot across the candlelit table, Catherine leaning slightly forward.
EP49:E23 33600-37600 CATHERINE: "Today went better than either of us planned for. The whole court watched you humiliate her."
EP49:E24 37800-44600 CAMERA: Medium close-up on Father Thomas as he turns his head slightly, scanning the dusty shadowed recesses of the abandoned room.
EP49:E25 38000-44300 FATHER THOMAS: "Fitting choice, this room. A place the family forgot for a conversation they mustn't remember."
EP49:E26 44600-47600 CAMERA: Close-up on Catherine, her lips curling into an amused, knowing smile.
EP49:E27 44800-47300 CATHERINE: "You always did have a taste for symbolism."
EP49:E28 47600-52000 CAMERA: Medium shot of Father Thomas, a subtle smirk breaking through his austere demeanor.
EP49:E29 47800-51900 FATHER THOMAS: "And you always did have a taste for using me. It's why we suit each other."
EP49:E30 52000-57000 CAMERA: Close-up on Catherine, her expression turning razor-sharp and commanding.
EP49:E31 52200-57000 CATHERINE: "Then make certain the council remembers that for the full ten days, not just the first hour."

CANDIDATE=c_90b3b51146cfbaab DURATION_MS=42800
SEGMENT 1 (playback order)
EP49:E38 0-2800 CAMERA: Close-up on Father Thomas absorbing the audacity of her demand.
EP49:E39 200-2600 FATHER THOMAS: "You want eyes inside the council chamber itself?"
EP49:E40 2800-6600 CAMERA: Close-up low angle on Catherine, tilting her chin up in defiant pride.
EP49:E41 3000-6400 CATHERINE: "I want eyes and ears everywhere that decides my future."
EP49:E42 6600-12400 CAMERA: Full two-shot of Catherine and Father Thomas facing off across the small table in the cavernous hallway.
EP49:E43 6800-11100 ACTION: Father Thomas clasps his hands behind his back, turning slightly away to ponder the gravity of her words.
EP49:E44 6900-11800 CATHERINE: "Is that so unreasonable coming from a woman the church itself just humiliated back into relevance?"
EP49:E45 12400-21600 CAMERA: Medium shot on Father Thomas turning back around to face her, his countenance etched with genuine concern.
EP49:E46 12800-21400 FATHER THOMAS: "If I keep the hearing open, if I feed you every word spoken behind those doors, what happens to me when the Duke finds out a crowned priest conspired against him?"
EP49:E47 21600-26600 CAMERA: Medium two-shot tracking closer as Catherine steps closer toward him.
EP49:E48 21800-26400 CATHERINE: "Then make certain he doesn't find out. You're careful. I've seen how careful."
EP49:E49 26600-33400 CAMERA: Tight close-up on Father Thomas's intense, brooding face.
EP49:E50 26800-33100 FATHER THOMAS: "Careful men still hang, my lady, when the crime is treason against a Duke the King himself just restored."
EP49:E51 33400-37400 CAMERA: Close-up on Catherine, her lips parting into an alluring, promising smile.
EP49:E52 33600-37100 CATHERINE: "Careful men who help me also get remembered."
EP49:E53 37400-42800 CAMERA: Split focus close-up between Father Thomas's intense gaze and Catherine leaning in close, whispering with lethal conviction.
EP49:E54 37800-42800 CATHERINE: "A grateful Duchess collects debts differently than a desperate one."
